description: This file defines the HistoryRepository class, which manages persisting and retrieving sharing history records for an Android application. It provides methods to add records, retrieve the list of share history items, and clear the stored history.

classes.name: HistoryRepository
classes.description: A class that manages storing and retrieving sharing history records using shared preferences.

methods.name: addShareRecord
methods.description: Adds a new sharing record to the history, storing fileName, method, and timestamp.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves the list of all stored share history items.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all stored share history records.

methods.name: loadArray
methods.description: Loads the share history records as a JSONArray from shared preferences.

methods.name: saveArray
methods.description: Saves the provided JSONArray of share history records into shared preferences.
